title: Only 7% Can Pass This Vision Test
summary: Tiny differences, shifting patterns and optical traps test whether your eyes catch what most people miss.

landing.intro: How sharp are your eyes? Spot tiny differences, track shifting patterns and catch visual traps before they catch you.

about.body:
This entertainment challenge contains ten visual puzzles covering colour contrast, detail matching, spatial orientation, pattern tracking, attention and visual memory. The tasks become more demanding without relying on specialist terminology.

Study each image or symbol set carefully, then choose the answer best supported by what is shown. Some questions test perception and attention rather than eyesight itself.

This is not an eye examination, medical vision test or diagnosis. Seek qualified eye-care advice if you have concerns about your sight.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete ten carefully selected questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one answer each time. Correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.
Reveal your result, skill breakdown and complete answer review after the final question.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This quiz is not an eye examination and cannot diagnose vision conditions.

checkpoint.finalAdNote: One short ad, then your results.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your vision-challenge score and three-skill breakdown are ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Eagle Eye
profile-1.copy: You caught subtle shifts that most people would scan straight past. Your focus stayed exceptionally precise as the patterns, rotations and visual traps became harder.

profile-2.title: The Visual Virtuoso
profile-2.copy: You passed the challenge with a sharp eye for structure, contrast and tiny changes. Even the late-round optical traps rarely pulled your attention off course.

profile-3.title: The Pattern Spotter
profile-3.copy: You tracked most visual rules confidently and noticed details hidden inside busy displays. A few close comparisons made the focus lab genuinely challenging.

profile-4.title: The Detail Detective
profile-4.copy: You built a solid result across several kinds of visual puzzle. Your strongest round shows where your attention naturally locks on fastest.

profile-5.title: The Focus Finder
profile-5.copy: You uncovered plenty of the lab’s hidden clues while discovering which visual traps slow you down. A second look would make many of the missed patterns click.

profile-6.title: The Curious Observer
profile-6.copy: This set of visual traps found some blind spots, but it also revealed where your focus is strongest. Every missed clue becomes obvious once the underlying rule is exposed.
